description: Monthly budget limit of the account (CAD, calendar month America/Toronto) and its optional daily limit (`daily`): the limit, the spend this month / today, the percentage used, what remains, and whether the limit was reached. When the limit is reached, every running hourly server is put into hibernation (no data lost; prepaid servers are not affected) and new deployments, starts, orders, card charges and automatic reloads are refused with BUDGET_LIMIT_REACHED. (permission: billing:read) [Requires a free GPU Cloud account and MCP key]
name: gpucloud_get_budget
title: Account budget limit
